lines.text: After three quiet years, Jehoshaphat visits Ahab, who asks him to fight Aram for Ramoth-gilead, and Jehoshaphat agrees.
Jehoshaphat asks Ahab to inquire of the LORD, so Ahab gathers about four hundred prophets, who all say go up.
Ahab and Jehoshaphat sit on thrones at the threshing floor by the gate of Jezreel, while Zedekiah's iron horns promise victory over the Moabites.
Micaiah describes Israel as scattered sheep, then the LORD on His throne, and a lying spirit entering Ahab's prophets.
Zedekiah strikes Micaiah, and Ahab orders him returned to Amon and Joash and put in prison on bread and water until Ahab returns.

wrong_details.wrong: Ahab orders him returned to Amon and Joash and put in prison
wrong_details.true: Micaiah is told he will see on the day Zedekiah hides in an inner room, then Ahab orders him imprisoned
